publicMHBArchitecturesCompatibleWithThes.description: A secret award threshold is selected within a reset-to-boundary interval and the jackpot is awarded when meter progression reaches/crosses it.
Each wager/spin is evaluated against a state-dependent trigger set whose award probability increases as the meter approaches the must-hit-by boundary.

operatorObservation.interpretation: Compatible with several MHB architectures; one cycle does not identify the architecture or distribution.

reason: Different MHB architectures fit all currently verified PowerPlay evidence but imply different next-spin hazards and optimal entry policies.
